summary: This script sets two environment variables that define the numeric user and group identifiers (IDs) to 1000. These are typically used in containerized environments like Docker to specify which user account should own files or run processes inside the container.

explanations.1: OS_USERID is being set to 1000, which is the numeric identifier for a user account in Linux/Unix systems. In Docker containers, 1000 is conventionally the first non-root user.
explanations.2: OS_GROUPID is being set to 1000, which is the numeric identifier for a group in Linux/Unix systems. Matching it to the user ID is a common practice for ensuring consistent file ownership.
